name: INFRAX RENEWABLE LIMITED
about: Infrax Renewable Limited provides solar energy EPC services. The company provides services, including expert consultation, custom system design, professional installation, after sales support, free site survey, system design and installation, power generation support, rooftop solar installations, commercial and industrial solar solutions, ground mounted solar systems, residential solar solutions, loan assistance, back office and technical support, and energy planning. The company caters to residential, commercial, industrial, and large scale solar power installation sectors. Infrax Renewable Limited was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Rajkot, India.
